text: Artificial intelligence is rapidly changing the world of creativity. Today, AI can generate stunning paintings, compose original music, and even write short stories or poems. Some people believe this threatens human artists, but others see it as a helpful tool. While AI can learn from millions of examples and produce new combinations quickly, its work lacks genuine emotional experience. A machine doesn't truly know love, loss, or joy; it only imitates patterns. Human creativity comes from real life, intuition, and personal struggle. So, instead of replacing us, AI might act as a collaborator, inspiring us and helping us explore ideas we hadn't considered before.
